I've been thinking a lot, lately, on how to avoid some of the problems that I've seen over the years when you have a forum such as this. And these are the ideas that I have to avoid some of the problems that exist elsewhere. It's a long read, so I appreciate anyone who makes it all of the way through.

On moderator levels:

Level 1: first clearance level. Access to all areas of subverse settings. No restrictions.

Level 2: second clearance level. Access to most areas of subverse settings. Some restrictions. Unable to add more moderators.

That's how it currently is. I think it would work better this way;

Change Level 2 to be the same as Level 1. Only differentiating factor being that Level 1 is considered the subverse "owner" and is the only person who can add or remove Level 2 moderators.

Create a Level 3 that takes place of the current Level 2

A subverse is only allowed to have Level 2 moderators until at least 3 Level 2 moderators exist. Until that time adding/removing Level 2 moderators would work just like it does today.

Require subverses to meet those minimums once they pass a certain threshold of subscribers (1,000+ as an example) or risk being delisted from /v/all.

Once a subverse reaches 4 or more moderators the following would come into play;

Additional Level 2 moderators would require the approval of the other Level 2 moderators. A Level 1 moderator puts a user up for Level 2 moderator (or wishes to promote a Level 3 to Level 2). The Level 2 moderators get a message such as:

MainMod wishes to promote NewbMod from Level 3 moderation to Level 2 moderation in a subverse that you moderate. Please indicate below how you feel about this proposed change to /v/subverse.

☐ I agree

☐ I disagree

Moderator removal (Including Level 1) can be initiated by Level 1 or Level 2 moderators and must be approved by a majority of Level 1 and Level 2 moderators.

Allow a Level 1 moderator to transfer subverse ownership to a Level 2 moderator. Much like the addition or removal of Level 2 moderators above, this transfer would require the approval of the majority of Level 2 moderators. And, just as above, once initiated by a Level 1 moderator the Level 2 moderators would get a message such as

MainMod wishes to transfer ownership of /v/subverse to NewbMod. Please indicate below how you feel about this proposed change to /v/subverse.

☐ I agree

☐ I disagree

In the event that a Level 1 moderator is removed by the Level 2 moderating team each user has to indicate who the new owner of the subverse should be as well as indicate which Level 3 moderator they believe should be promoted to Level 2 (if the shift would lead to less than the minimum amount of Level 2 moderators).

So let's play out this scenario. A subverse has the following mod team;

Moderator Level
Fred Level 1
Wilma Level 2
Barney Level 2
Betty Level 2
Bam-Bam Level 3
Pebbles Level 3
Dino Level 3

Fred wants to focus on his ballet lessons and feels that it's his duty to transfer ownership of /v/bedrock to Wilma, who he trusts to run the place in his stead. He initiates the transfer and Barney and Betty cast their vote. Betty and Barney agree and Wilma is voted in as the new owner pending the promotion of a Level 3 moderator. Wilma, Betty, and Barney all cast their vote on who that new Level 2 moderator should be. Wilma votes for Pebbles, Barney and Betty vote for Bam-Bam. Bam-Bam becomes a Level 2 moderator and the ownership of /v/bedrock is transferred to Wilma.

Or the vote on ownership goes through but Wilma votes for Pebbles as the new Level 2 mod, Barney votes for Bam-Bam, and Betty votes for Dino. It's a draw. The moderators are notified that the vote ended in a draw and are asked to vote again. Once a Level 3 moderator wins by popular vote that person is promoted to Level 2 and the transfer in ownership goes through.

Or maybe Fred left for work one day at the quarry and just never came back home. He's been absent for quite some time and the subverse is growing every day. Wilma initiates the process for removal of Fred as subverse owner and chooses herself as new owner. Betty and Barney both vote to remove Fred as well, but they each vote for themselves as the new owner. Fred is removed as owner and the Level 2 moderators make a request to the admin team for the transfer of ownership.

Or Betty agrees with Wilma and votes for her to be the new owner too. The moderators then vote on the new Level 2 moderator just as above.

In my opinion this would prevent subverse owners from stacking the deck in their favor, giving away their subverse on a drunken whim, and prevent hostile takeovers of popular subverses.
